title: Random Password Generator
description: Use the random module to generate a secure‑looking password of customizable length.
problemStatement: Write a script `password_gen.py` that defines a function `generate_password(length=16)` which returns a random password containing a mix of uppercase, lowercase, digits, and punctuation. Use `random.choice()` on a string of allowed characters. Print 5 generated passwords of length 20 each to demonstrate. Make sure to import the necessary modules.
hints: Create a character set: `chars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + string.punctuation`.
Use a loop or list comprehension: `''.join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(length))`.
expectedOutput: Five random passwords of length 20 printed, each on a new line.
